features: Release Manager separates a physically installed Staging build from an Available release and from a worker-validated Tested on Staging release
Special-category scoring round view avoids duplicate bootstrap loading when embedding the standard manual scoring core, preventing the round-view HTTP 500 regression
Release Manager requires real worker-backed Staging deployment proof before a candidate can become Tested on Staging or unlock Production
Environment-isolated Result Repository resolution keeps Production on Production storage and Staging on Staging storage while restoring legacy historical document links by filename

Special-category scoring for Bachata Rising, Bachata Open and Bachata Invitational with fixed points mapped to role-specific Novice, Intermediate or Advanced BDC progression buckets and unchanged BDC ID assignment
